text.zh-CN:
消化性溃疡是胃或十二指肠内壁出现破损，可引起上腹痛或出血。

- 十二指肠是连接胃的小肠起始段，也会发生溃疡。
- 疼痛可能像烧灼，伴腹胀、恶心或消化不良。
- 症状轻重不能可靠反映破损程度，需要针对原因治疗。
text.en:
Peptic ulcers are sores in the stomach or first part of the small intestine.

- The duodenum is the bowel segment immediately after the stomach.
- Burning upper-abdominal pain, nausea or bloating may occur.
- Symptom intensity alone does not establish severity.

text.zh-CN:
常见原因是感染和药物损伤。

- 幽门螺杆菌是一种可在胃内生存的细菌，可导致溃疡。
- 经常使用布洛芬等消炎止痛药会增加风险。
- 吸烟和年龄增加也与风险有关；不能仅把溃疡归因于吃辣或压力。
text.en:
Common causes involve infection or medicine-related injury.

- H. pylori is a bacterium that can live in the stomach and cause ulcers.
- Regular anti-inflammatory painkiller use raises risk.
- Smoking and older age also matter; spicy food or stress alone does not explain every ulcer.

text.zh-CN:
出血或穿孔迹象需要急救。

- 呕吐鲜血或咖啡渣样物，应立即就医。
- 黑色、黏稠的大便或明显便血，需要紧急评估。
- 突然剧烈腹痛、触碰腹部很痛或新发胸痛，不要继续自行试胃药。
text.en:
Bleeding or possible perforation needs emergency care.

- Vomiting blood or coffee-ground material requires immediate help.
- Black sticky stools or visible bleeding needs urgent assessment.
- Sudden severe abdominal or chest pain must not be managed by repeatedly trying antacids.

text.zh-CN:
持续和变化的症状值得检查。

- 反复上腹痛或常规处理后仍消化不良，应预约评估。
- 无意消瘦、很少进食就饱、食欲下降或反复呕吐，应尽快就医。
- 吞咽困难、持续疲劳等也应主动说明。
text.en:
Persistent or changing symptoms deserve investigation.

- Recurrent upper-abdominal pain or ongoing indigestion needs review.
- Weight loss, early fullness, poor appetite or repeated vomiting needs prompt care.
- Mention swallowing problems and persistent fatigue.

text.zh-CN:
检查既确认损伤，也寻找病因。

- 呼气或粪便检测可寻找幽门螺杆菌感染。
- 胃镜通过细软管上的镜头直接查看食管、胃和十二指肠。
- 是否需要化验、胃镜和复查，由症状及风险决定，不能凭疼痛时间自行区分溃疡类型。
text.en:
Tests assess damage and its cause.

- Breath or stool testing can look for H. pylori.
- Endoscopy uses a flexible camera to inspect the upper digestive tract.
- Testing depends on risk and symptoms; pain timing alone does not classify an ulcer.

text.zh-CN:
上腹不适有许多其他原因。

- 胃食管反流和其他消化不良也可出现烧灼感。
- 持续消瘦、吞咽困难或反复呕吐需要排查更严重的问题。
- 突然胸痛需要考虑心脏等急症，不能因同时反酸就认定来自胃。
text.en:
Upper-abdominal discomfort has several alternatives.

- Reflux and other indigestion can also cause burning.
- Weight loss, difficulty swallowing or repeated vomiting needs assessment for serious causes.
- Sudden chest pain requires consideration of cardiac emergencies even with acid symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
治疗需要针对溃疡形成的原因。

- 幽门螺杆菌感染通常需要组合抗感染治疗。
- 抑酸药减少胃酸，帮助破损黏膜恢复。
- 医生会核对可能致病的止痛药，并决定停换或保护方案。
text.en:
Treatment addresses the cause.

- H. pylori usually requires combination eradication treatment.
- Acid suppression helps the damaged lining heal.
- Potentially contributing pain medicines need review and a supervised alternative or protective plan.

text.zh-CN:
药物缓解症状不等于已治愈。

- 抗生素应按完整处方服用，症状好转也不能自行删减。
- 质子泵抑制剂是一类减少胃酸的药，疗程按病因调整。
- 有溃疡史时，不自行加用消炎止痛药；正在用的重要处方药先与医生讨论。
- 若使用抗生素，可能出现恶心或腹泻；呼吸困难、咽喉紧或口舌肿胀可能是严重过敏，应立即求助。
text.en:
Feeling better does not establish healing.

- Follow the full antibiotic prescription rather than removing components yourself.
- Proton pump inhibitors reduce acid; treatment duration depends on the cause.
- Discuss anti-inflammatory painkillers and existing essential medicines with the clinician.
- When antibiotics are used, nausea or diarrhoea may occur; breathing difficulty, throat tightness or mouth or tongue swelling may signal a serious allergy and need immediate help.

text.zh-CN:
饮食主要帮助减轻不适。

- 可以尝试较小份量，避免一次吃得过撑。
- 减少自己反复观察到会诱发不适的食物或酒精，不要求人人禁同样的食物。
- 饮食调整不能清除幽门螺杆菌，也不能替代溃疡治疗。
text.en:
Diet mainly helps comfort.

- Smaller meals may be easier to tolerate.
- Adjust foods or alcohol that reproducibly worsen symptoms rather than applying a universal ban.
- Diet cannot eradicate H. pylori or replace ulcer treatment.

text.zh-CN:
护理时注意症状与药物记录。

- 记录痛的位置、出血迹象和所有止痛药使用情况。
- 避免临睡前大餐，并按安排坚持治疗。
- 戒烟、管理压力可支持恢复，但症状恶化仍需医学评估。
text.en:
Keep track of symptoms and medicines.

- Record pain, possible bleeding and all painkiller use.
- Avoid large late meals and follow the treatment plan.
- Smoking cessation and stress support can help, but worsening still needs assessment.

text.zh-CN:
既往疾病和用药会改变风险。

- 经常需要消炎止痛药的人，应讨论替代方法和胃保护。
- 老年人或同时使用多种药物者，需完整核对药物清单。
- 孕期或哺乳期应提前说明，以便选择适合的检查和药物。
text.en:
Other illnesses and medicines influence care.

- Frequent anti-inflammatory use calls for alternatives and protection discussion.
- Older people and those taking several medicines need a full review.
- Mention pregnancy or breastfeeding before tests and prescribing.

text.zh-CN:
疗程和复查安排因原因而异。

- 治疗可能持续数周，症状消失后仍需完成约定方案。
- 有时需要复查确认感染清除或溃疡恢复，按医生安排进行。
- 复发时重新评估病因和药物，而不是长期重复旧疗程。
text.en:
Treatment and follow-up vary by cause.

- Treatment may last several weeks; continue the agreed course even when symptoms settle.
- Follow-up testing may confirm eradication or healing.
- Recurrence needs reassessment rather than endless reuse of an old regimen.

text.zh-CN:
溃疡可能造成超出疼痛的损害。

- 出血可导致缺铁性贫血，表现为疲劳等不适。
- 穿孔指胃肠壁出现贯通破口，可引起严重腹腔感染。
- 幽门螺杆菌长期未处理与胃癌风险有关，但不等于每个溃疡都会癌变。
text.en:
Ulcers can cause problems beyond pain.

- Bleeding can lead to iron-deficiency anaemia and fatigue.
- Perforation is a hole through the wall that can cause severe abdominal infection.
- Untreated H. pylori is linked to cancer risk without making every ulcer cancerous.

text.zh-CN:
减少复发需要处理可改变的因素。

- 完成幽门螺杆菌治疗，并按约复查。
- 不要长期自行服用消炎止痛药，必要用药应评估风险。
- 戒烟并限制会加重不适的酒精摄入，复发症状及时复诊。
text.en:
Prevention focuses on modifiable causes.

- Complete H. pylori treatment and follow-up.
- Avoid unsupervised prolonged anti-inflammatory use.
- Stop smoking, limit aggravating alcohol and seek review of recurrence.
